actions.title: Try one AI writing tool this week
actions.description: Pick a repetitive writing task (emails, reports, summaries) and use ChatGPT or Claude to draft it. Edit the output rather than writing from scratch.

actions.title: Automate a manual data task
actions.description: Identify one task where you're copying data between systems, reformatting spreadsheets, or doing repetitive lookups. Use an AI tool or simple automation to handle it.

actions.title: Audit your weekly tasks for AI potential
actions.description: Spend 20 minutes listing everything you did last week. Mark each task: AI could do this, AI could help, or only I can do this. The pattern will surprise you.

actions.title: Set up an AI assistant for meeting notes
actions.description: Use an AI meeting tool (Otter, Fireflies, or built-in Zoom/Teams AI) to auto-transcribe and summarize your next meeting. Compare the summary to your manual notes.

actions.title: Learn one AI prompt pattern
actions.description: Master the 'role + context + task + format' prompt structure. Apply it to three different work tasks this week. Quality of AI output depends on quality of input.
actions.scoreImpact: Doubles the usefulness of any AI tool

actions.title: Build an AI-assisted workflow for your top task
actions.description: Take your highest-volume recurring task and redesign it with AI in the loop. Document the before/after process so your team can follow it.

actions.title: Replace one manual review process with AI + human check
actions.description: Let AI handle the first pass on document review, data validation, or quality checks. You review AI's output instead of doing it from scratch.

actions.title: Set up AI templates for recurring deliverables
actions.description: Create reusable AI prompts for reports, proposals, or analyses you produce regularly. Save them where your team can access and adapt them.

actions.title: Integrate AI into your existing tools
actions.description: Enable AI features in tools you already use (Copilot in Office, AI in Notion/Slack, Gemini in Google Workspace). The tools you pay for already have AI — turn it on.
actions.scoreImpact: Zero new tool cost, immediate gains

actions.title: Track your actual time savings for 2 weeks
actions.description: Log how much time AI saves you each day. Real numbers, not estimates. This data justifies expanding AI use to your team and leadership.

actions.title: Automate your reporting pipeline
actions.description: Connect your data sources to AI-powered reporting. Generate weekly summaries, dashboards, or client updates automatically. Focus your time on analysis, not assembly.

actions.title: Deploy AI agents for routine decisions
actions.description: Identify decisions that follow clear rules (scheduling, triage, categorization) and set up AI agents to handle them. You review exceptions, not every case.

actions.title: Train your team on AI-first workflows
actions.description: Run a 1-hour workshop showing your team how you use AI. Share your best prompts and workflows. The compounding effect of team-wide adoption far exceeds individual use.
actions.scoreImpact: Multiplies your impact across the team

actions.title: Build custom AI tools for your domain
actions.description: Create GPTs, Claude projects, or simple automations tailored to your specific industry knowledge. Generic tools give generic results — domain-specific tools give competitive advantage.

actions.title: Benchmark against AI-native competitors
actions.description: Research how AI-native companies in your space operate. Identify the processes they've fully automated. Use this as your roadmap for what's possible.

actions.title: Redesign your service offering around AI capabilities
actions.description: Your role has maximum AI potential. Rethink what you deliver — AI handles the production, you provide the judgment, creativity, and relationships that AI cannot.

actions.title: Build AI into your client-facing work
actions.description: Offer AI-enhanced deliverables to clients: faster turnaround, deeper analysis, more scenarios explored. Position AI as a feature of your service, not a secret.

actions.title: Invest in the skills AI cannot replicate
actions.description: Double down on relationship building, strategic thinking, creative direction, and ethical judgment. As AI handles more execution, these human skills become your moat.

actions.title: Mentor others on AI-native workflows
actions.description: Share your expertise. Write about what works, speak at events, advise peers. The transition you've made is what everyone else needs to learn.

actions.title: Explore agentic AI for end-to-end automation
actions.description: Pilot AI agents that handle entire workflows autonomously — research, drafting, review, delivery. You set the strategy and quality bar; AI executes.
